issues.competing_evidence: Tovmassian+01 ROSAT spectral fit reports unabsorbed 0.1–2.4 keV flux 1.1e−11 erg cm−2 s−1 for a fixed-25 eV BB+brems model and NH=4.5e20; Ridder+23 Table 3 gives model-converted RASS 1–10 keV 2.3±0.5e−12 and 0.1–10 keV 2.8±0.5e−12, using assumed spectral components/PIMMS and Voges+99 catalog rates. The bands, NH and models differ; no source-specific reconciliation was found.
issues.why_it_matters: X-ray luminosity/state comparisons depend on flux band, absorption convention and spectral model; the two values must not be silently merged.
issues.needed_action: Retrieve the original ROSAT source spectrum/catalog response and reproduce the source-specific count-to-flux conversions under the published models, or document why they are not directly comparable; retain both values until then.

issues.competing_evidence: Barrett+20 Table 2 labels 3563±730 G as donor magnetic field from fundamental ECM, but §4.2 permits emission from either the accretion column or donor lower corona and favors the donor corona only under assumed system/plasma parameters. Tovmassian+01 separately estimates 20 or 24 MG from optical cyclotron harmonics in the accretion region.
issues.why_it_matters: The kG radio-plasma field and MG cyclotron estimate refer to different diagnostics/components; assigning the kG value to the WD surface or donor without caveat changes interpretation.
issues.needed_action: For catalog use, retain the radio field as an ECM-emitting-plasma estimate with location unassigned and the donor-corona interpretation tentative; if a specific component label is needed, decide whether the conditional Barrett+20 preference is sufficient.

issues.competing_evidence: Barrett+17 §3 says LW Cam was one of seven targets not detected at an approximate 120 μJy limit. Table 4 lists six band/epoch image peak statistics and local standard deviations but no source-specific formal per-band limit; LW Cam is not in the secure detections table.
issues.why_it_matters: Exact band-dependent upper limits matter for radio-variability and population comparisons; Table 4 statistics are not detections.
issues.needed_action: If exact limits are required, retrieve the archived JVLA images or ask the authors for per-band rms/limit products; otherwise retain only the approximate survey-level limit and six image statistics as separate records.

issues.competing_evidence: Barrett+20 Table 2 gives radio luminosity 357 in units of 10^21 erg s−1 using distance 542 pc, flux 50 μJy and a 256 MHz bandwidth footnote, but the precise formula is not specified in the table. The number is consistent with d²SνΔν without the usual isotropic 4π factor.
issues.why_it_matters: Using the value alongside isotropic radio luminosities could bias cross-source comparisons by a convention-dependent factor.
issues.needed_action: Verify the paper’s luminosity definition or author calculation. Until resolved, retain 357×10^21 erg s−1 only as the published tabulated quantity and exclude it from isotropic-luminosity comparisons; if a recomputed value is needed, log it separately with formula and assumptions.
